transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

Well… I guess it’s mostly work stress, or at least that’s how it probably sounds. I do mathematical modeling work, environmental modeling, and lately I’ve been having a hard time shaking the feeling that some people on this contract are tracking my revisions and… putting errors into the datasets. Like to make it seem like I’m not capable of leading it.

I know that might sound a little strong. My wife says it’s probably just version-control mistakes, and some of the junior analysts have said the same. I’m trying to be reasonable about it. But it keeps happening in ways that feel too specific to be accidental, if that makes sense.
How long have you been noticing and worrying about this pattern with your coworkers—days, weeks, or longer?

It’s been… longer than days. I’d say around two months, give or take. I don’t want to overstate it, but that’s about when I started feeling pretty sure the revisions were being watched and the errors weren’t just random. Does that answer what you mean?
Besides these concerns about your coworkers, have you experienced hearing voices or sounds, or seeing or sensing things that others don't seem to notice?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t been hearing voices or seeing things, not like that. It’s more… concerns about the files and the work, if that makes sense. I’m trying to be accurate here.

Over these past two months, have you also noticed changes in your mood—like feeling unusually elevated, irritable, or energetic, or on the other hand, very low or depressed—along with these concerns about your coworkers?

I’m not sure I’d call it that, exactly. I haven’t felt, you know, unusually high or full of energy or anything. And I wouldn’t say I’ve been depressed in a major way.

Maybe more tense or worn down because of the work situation, but that seems… understandable, I think. I’m trying not to make it sound worse than it is. Does that distinction make sense?

Do you have any medical conditions, neurological problems, or are you taking any medications, supplements, or substances—including alcohol or recreational drugs—that started or changed around the same time these concerns began?

Nothing really comes to mind, no. I can’t think of any medication or supplement changes around then, and I don’t think there was anything medical or neurological that started at the same time.

I mean, if there’s something specific you want me to check or think through, I can, but offhand I don’t have anything like that to report. Does that answer it okay?
Have you had any recent head injuries, seizures, fainting spells, or noticed any changes in your memory, concentration, or thinking clarity around the time these concerns started?

No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had a head injury or seizures or fainting that I can recall. And as far as memory or thinking… I mean, I’ve been stressed and maybe a little preoccupied, but I wouldn’t say there’s been a clear change in my thinking or concentration.

If there’s something specific you’re looking for, I can try to think about it more carefully.
